name: Whitepages
notes: Requires locating your listing before suppression. You will receive an automated phone call with a verification code that you must enter via keypad. Removal typically takes 24-72 hours.

name: Spokeo
notes: Covers Spokeo and AnyWho (anywho.com/optout redirects here). Find your profile at spokeo.com first, paste its URL into the form, then click the confirmation link Spokeo emails you.

name: FastPeopleSearch
notes: Search for your listing first, then request removal. 72-hour removal time. Email verification required.

name: TruePeopleSearch
notes: Search for your profile first at truepeoplesearch.com. Email verification required. 72-hour removal.

name: Nuwber
notes: Search for your profile at nuwber.com first, then use removal link. 24-hour removal. Email verification required.

name: CheckPeople
notes: Requires legal name and birthdate. Search first at checkpeople.com.

name: ThatsThem
notes: Straightforward opt-out process. No email verification required.

name: SmartBackgroundChecks
notes: Email verification required for removal.

name: BeenVerified
notes: One opt-out covers the BeenVerified sites: BeenVerified, PeopleLooker, Ownerly, NeighborWho and NumberGuru. Search for your record first, then submit the opt-out. Email confirmation required. Only ONE opt-out per email address; contact privacy@beenverified.com for additional removals. Processing takes 24-72 hours.

name: PeopleConnect
notes: One suppression request covers the PeopleConnect sites: Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, US Search, Zabasearch and Addresses.com (PublicRecords360 redirects to US Search). Requires email verification and account creation. Processing takes up to 72 hours. Alternative: call (877) 564-3253 or email privacy@peopleconnect.us.

name: MyLife
notes: MyLife's 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' opt-out form (linked from its privacy policy). Non-CA residents report mixed success. Email verification required.

name: FamilyTreeNow
notes: Search for your profile first at familytreenow.com, then use opt-out link on your profile page.

name: USPhoneBook
notes: Enter your name and email address and complete the CAPTCHA. The site emails a link to the opt-out form; the link expires after 24 hours.

name: PeopleSearchNow
notes: Search for your profile first, then submit opt-out. Email verification required.

name: AdvancedBackgroundChecks
notes: Enter your name and email; the site emails a link to the full opt-out form. It states records can reappear when new public records arrive, so re-check later.

name: NeighborReport
notes: Search for your address first at neighbor.report. Email verification required.

name: PeopleFinders
notes: Major people search engine. Email verification required. Search for profile first.

name: InfoTracer
notes: Public records search. Email verification required.

name: SearchQuarry
notes: Privacy choices page: turns off the site's advertising tags and explains how to send privacy requests about SearchQuarry member accounts. The page says SearchQuarry no longer sells new memberships and that its reports now come from TruthFinder and BeenVerified, whose records it cannot change, so also do the PeopleConnect and BeenVerified opt-outs.

name: SearchBug
notes: Privacy requests hub. Choose 'Opt-Out / Do Not Sell' and press 'Submit opt-out request': that suppresses your record from Searchbug's public people search and opens the contact form where the request is sent. The page says no photo ID is needed for an opt-out. 'Request Deletion' on the same page is for Searchbug account holders and does need photo ID.

name: PeopleByName
notes: People directory. Simple removal form.

name: OldFriends
notes: Classmate finder. No online form - you must email their privacy team directly to request removal.

name: PrivateRecords
notes: Privacy requests page, opened on 'Remove My Information', which stops results for a person being returned. It asks for the person's name, date of birth, city, state and ZIP, plus an email address or phone number, and needs one confirmation click afterwards. The other option on the page, 'Your Privacy Choices', only stops selling and sharing; it does not remove a listing.

name: PropertyRecords
notes: Property and owner information database. No dedicated opt-out form - you must contact them via help page to request removal.

name: Classmates
notes: Classmates' request form (Classmates is run by PeopleConnect, Inc.). Choose 'State Law Data Privacy Request' to ask for deletion or to opt out of the sale or sharing of your information; the privacy policy says you can also email privacy@classmates.com. They will ask for some details to match the request to your profile. Members can instead cancel their account from the Help Center article 'How can I cancel my membership?'.

name: Acxiom
notes: Major marketing data aggregator. One opt-out request page (replaces the old isapps.acxiom.com form and the separate 'Do Not Sell' page). Stops Acxiom using your data for marketing; it does not recall data already shared with marketers.

name: Epsilon
notes: Major marketing data aggregator ($2.9B revenue). Uses third-party identity verification. Alternative: email optout@epsilon.com with full name and mailing address. Processing takes up to 2 weeks.

name: Experian
notes: Experian's consumer privacy portal: opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information and of its use for marketing. Stops marketing use only; it does not change your credit file.
Phone directory operated by Whitepages. The 'Your Privacy Choices' page links the deletion and opt-out requests; follow the steps there by hand.

name: YellowPages
notes: Yellowpages.com (owned by Thryv) is a business directory; its 'Find People' link now sends you to Intelius, which the PeopleConnect entry covers. This page has a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' button that stops ad-network sharing for this browser only: it is stored in a cookie, so repeat it in each browser and after clearing cookies. No account needed. For access or deletion requests, Thryv's privacy notice (thryv.com/privacy) links to a separate request form.

name: VoterRecords
notes: Voter registration data. Uses contact form - you must request removal through their contact page. Note: Voter records are public in most states, so removal may be limited.

name: CocoFinder
notes: Growing people search site. Search for your profile first, then submit opt-out request. Email verification required. Processing takes 24-72 hours.

name: CyberBackgroundChecks
notes: Background check service. Search for your record first at cyberbackgroundchecks.com. Email verification required.

name: GladIKnow
notes: People search site. You MUST first search for your profile at gladiknow.com, copy the profile URL, and include it in your opt-out request.

name: PeopleWhiz
notes: People search and background check site. Search for your listing first. Email verification required.

name: USAPeopleSearch
notes: Enter your name and email address and complete the CAPTCHA. The site emails a link to the opt-out form; the link expires after 24 hours.

name: Unmask
notes: Phone number and people search. Find your profile first, then submit opt-out. Email verification required.

name: LexisNexis
notes: MAJOR DATA BROKER. One of the largest consumer data aggregators. Comprehensive opt-out form with identity verification. Alternative: call 1-800-456-6004 or mail request to LexisNexis Consumer Center, P.O. Box 105108, Atlanta, GA 30348. Processing takes 30 days.

name: OptOutPrescreen
notes: Official site run by Equifax, Experian, Innovis and TransUnion to stop pre-approved credit and insurance offers from all four. Online opt-out lasts 5 years; a mailed form makes it permanent. Stops offers only; it does not remove a people-search listing. The site refuses automated browsers, so open it yourself.

name: DataAxle (InfoUSA/Donnelley)
notes: MAJOR DATA BROKER. Formerly InfoUSA/Donnelley Marketing. Provides data to direct marketers. Data Axle's own Consumer Privacy Rights Request form: name, full postal address, email and phone are required; pick 'opt out of the sale or sharing' (or deletion) under Privacy Choice. The site's footer link 'Do Not Sell or Share My Data' leads to this same form. Privacy contact listed in the policy: privacyteam@data-axle.com.

name: Clearview AI
notes: FACIAL RECOGNITION. The Privacy & Requests page lists the request forms by state and region (deletion and opt-out). May require a photo of your face. Not available to residents of every state.

name: Precise Leads (NumLookup)
notes: Reverse phone lookup. Removes your information from NumLookup's phone and name lookup. Provide the phone number you want removed.

name: RecordsFinder
notes: Public records search engine. Find your record first at recordsfinder.com. Email verification required.

name: AncestryFree (RootsWeb)
notes: Ancestry's help article on content removal (RootsWeb is run by Ancestry). Its 'Request content removal' link opens a report form where you can report information about you or your living minor children. Ancestry also lists privacy@ancestry.com and usprivacyrequests@ancestry.com for privacy requests. If you have an Ancestry account, trees you created are removed from your own account settings instead.

name: DMAChoice (Direct Marketing Association)
notes: MAJOR. Industry opt-out service. Register to opt out of unsolicited commercial mail, email, and phone calls from DMA member companies. Free. Takes effect in approximately 90 days. Re-register every 3 years.

name: National Do Not Call Registry
notes: FEDERAL. FTC's official Do Not Call registry. Register your phone number(s) to reduce telemarketing calls. Registration never expires. Takes up to 31 days to take effect. Does not block political calls, charities, surveys, or debt collectors.

name: Catalog Choice
notes: Non-profit service. Opt out of receiving unwanted catalogs, phone books, credit card offers, and other junk mail. Free account required. Works with over 10,000 companies.

name: Lusha
notes: B2B contact data platform. 'Request Removal' page in Lusha's privacy centre. Email verification required.

name: Apollo.io
notes: B2B sales contact database. 'Remove your information' request page.

name: RocketReach
notes: B2B contact finder. No online form — email privacy@rocketreach.co to request removal of your data.

name: Hunter.io
notes: Email finder service. No online form — email privacy@hunter.io to request removal. Reference CCPA/GDPR.

name: ContactOut
notes: LinkedIn email scraper. Extracts contact details from LinkedIn profiles. Online opt-out form.

name: FullContact
notes: Identity resolution platform. 'Exercise My Privacy Rights' page: opt-out and deletion requests, open to everyone regardless of location.

name: AtData (formerly TowerData)
notes: Email data broker; TowerData is now AtData. AtData's opt-out request page.

name: LiveRamp
notes: MAJOR DATA BROKER. One of the largest data onboarding/identity resolution platforms. Connects offline data to digital identities. This page offers three opt-outs. 'Opt Out as a Consumer, Agent, or Parent/Guardian/Conservator' opens a request form (first and last name, email, CAPTCHA) and covers every identifier LiveRamp links to you; it is open to everyone in the US. The other two cover only one mobile device's advertising ID or one browser's cookie.

name: Tapad
notes: Cross-device ad tracking (owned by Experian). Consumer Rights Request Portal for opt-out, access and deletion. Works on device identifiers, not your name, so it needs a separate request per device. Stops ad targeting; it does not remove a people-search listing.

name: Lotame
notes: Data management platform (DMP), now part of Epsilon. Collects and sells audience data for advertising. This page explains each way to opt out: Lotame's Browser Opt-Out Tool (lotame-optout.com) sets an opt-out cookie for one browser, and requests tied to an email address or device ID go through Epsilon's privacy request form (legal.epsilon.com/dsr). Ignore the newsletter sign-up box on the page: it is not part of the opt-out.

name: ShareThis
notes: Social sharing widget that also collects behavioral data across websites. Cookie-based opt-out available on their privacy page.

name: TrueCaller
notes: PHONE ID APP. Crowdsourced phone number identification. Unlisting page removes your number from their database. Must enter phone number. Takes up to 24 hours.

name: Hiya
notes: PHONE ID APP. 'Manage your data at Hiya' request form. A wrong caller name is a separate request, 'Remove incorrect name shown for a call', on Hiya's support request hub.

name: CallerSmart
notes: Phone lookup app. Reverse phone lookup and caller ID. Online opt-out form.

name: PeopleSmart
notes: People search engine. Find your listing, then submit opt-out. Email verification required.

name: RealPeopleSearch
notes: People search aggregator. Online opt-out with email verification.

name: NumLooker
notes: Phone reverse lookup service. Provide phone number to remove.

name: FastBackgroundCheck
notes: Background check site. Find your record, then submit opt-out request. Email verification required.

name: SocialCatfish
notes: Reverse image search and social media/identity lookup. Online opt-out with email verification.

name: Innovis
notes: 4TH CREDIT BUREAU. Often overlooked. Place a security freeze to prevent new accounts. May require government ID verification. Free under federal law.

name: Cotality (formerly CoreLogic)
notes: Property and tenant-screening data; CoreLogic is now Cotality. No direct form link: the Product Privacy Policy explains how to ask for deletion or opt out of sale, through its Online Privacy Portal, by email to privacy@cotality.com, or by phone at 1-866-221-9291.

name: Pipl
notes: Enterprise identity data broker. Used by businesses for identity verification. Submit removal request through their web form or email.

name: Melissa Data
notes: B2B address and identity verification broker. Email privacy@melissa.com to request removal. Reference CCPA if applicable.

name: Unacast (Gravy Analytics)
notes: Location data broker; Gravy Analytics merged into Unacast and gravyanalytics.com redirects there. 'Opt Out & Delete Request' page. Works on your phone's advertising ID.

name: PeopleSearchExpert
notes: People search aggregator. Online opt-out form available.

name: ValidNumber
notes: Reverse phone lookup. There is no single opt-out address: section 9 of this privacy policy explains the steps (look up the number on validnumber.com, then use the removal request on that number's page).

name: ChexSystems
notes: BANKING DATA. Tracks checking account history. Banks check this when you open a new account. Place a security freeze for free under federal law. May require ID upload.
